reviewed_stack_pointer_fields: Retain pointer-valued public-value and shared-owner fields at their original stack offsets.

_wm_probe_heap_add_region.declaration: bool add_region(unsigned long address,unsigned long size);

_wm_probe_heap_add_regions.declaration: bool add_regions(unsigned long *addresses,unsigned long *sizes,unsigned long count);

_wm_probe_heap_alloc_range.declaration: void *alloc_range(unsigned long size,unsigned long first,unsigned long last);

reviewed_allocator_forwarding.reason: Native allocator tail calls preserve byte-count and pointer arguments through the WMAP wire table. Explicit call contracts retain those arguments in C.

reviewed_keyword_dispatch_data.reason: Retain seven bounded native keyword-dispatch offsets as C data instead of reading text addresses.

reviewed_virtual_owner_calls.basis: Deleting destructor slot and reference-count guarded control-block release preserve the native owner argument.

reviewed_value_contracts.reason: Recover native value returns and full precision arguments before propagating them to callers.

reviewed_global_lookup_view.basis: Saved owner is a uint pointer; count and data loads at indices 0x18 and 0x16 address byte offsets 0x60 and 0x58.

reviewed_integer_loop_payload.basis: The integer loop compares the raw signed payload bits saved through a double spill; converting the subnormal double numerically truncates the bound to zero.

reviewed_postfix_selector.basis: ROR CL,1 leaves an eight-bit selector; C integer promotion must not retain the shifted upper bits.

reviewed_addition_payload.basis: The saved numeric sum is an IEEE-754 double, independently of the earlier token-kind byte held in the same native spill.

reviewed_boxed_integer_payloads.basis: These assignments are followed by integer kind/tag 1; preserve the signed integer bits in the aliased double storage rather than numerically converting them back to double.

reviewed_numeric_argument_and_negation.basis: Keep fractional arguments in a double spill and flip the IEEE-754 sign bit without numeric integer conversion.
